Tax software bugs are notoriously hard to detect because they manifest only in uncommon input combinations. An audit professional familiar with small fintech shops might legitimately treat 'visually abandoned product' as a weak prior for 'undertested calculation core,' effectively inverting the aesthetic-usability heuristic into a negative engineering signal. This is the strongest available argument that UI appearance could inform (though not cause) doubt about calculation reliability.
